### Pipeline 3: Pause-and-Pivot Surgical Frame Repair (Frame K)
**Purpose:** Fixes an artifact at exact **Frame K** (e.g., extra finger, warped prop, drifted face) while keeping every unmasked pixel 100% untouched so Frames `0 .. K-1` splice seamlessly into `Frame K`.

- **Two Ways to Mask (Nodes 2–7):**
  1. **Brush Mask in Director Studio:** Paint directly over the problem area on the Timeline canvas (loaded via Node `2`).
  2. **Text Auto-Mask (`Florence-2` + `SAM 2.1`):** Type a phrase like `"right hand"` in Node `4`; Florence-2 finds the bounding box and SAM 2.1 cuts a pixel-accurate mask, dilated & feathered by Node `7`.
- **Two Repair Engines (Nodes 10–13):**
  - **`FLUX.1-Kontext-dev` (Nodes 10–11):** Best for facial identity, gaze, expression, or posture fixes (`LoRA ~0.85`).
  - **`FLUX.1-Fill-dev` (Nodes 12–13):** Best for hands, props, clothing seams, or object removal (`LoRA capped <= 0.50` so Fill doesn't hallucinate faces onto hands).
- **Zero-Drift Guarantee:** Node `19` (`ImageCompositeMasked`) composites *only* the feathered mask back onto raw Frame K, guaranteeing a high Seam Continuity Score against Frame `K-1`.

_meta.title: 📖 READ FIRST — Pipeline 3: Surgical Frame K Repair
_meta.description: Explains Brush vs. Florence-2/SAM2 masking, Kontext vs. Fill repair engines, and unmasked pixel preservation.

_meta.title: [1] Load Extracted Raw Frame K
_meta.description: Exact uncompressed PNG extracted from the lossless FFV1 master at the frame where you paused.

_meta.title: [2] Load User-Painted Brush Mask (From Director Studio)
_meta.description: Binary mask painted on the Director Studio canvas. When provided, Shot Director routes this mask directly into Node 7.

_meta.title: [3] Load Florence-2 Vision Grounding Model
_meta.description: Vision-language model that locates objects or body parts in Frame K from plain-English text.

_meta.title: [4] Auto-Locate Target Phrase (Text -> Bounding Box)
_meta.description: Type what to fix (e.g., 'right hand', 'coffee mug', 'sunglasses') when you haven't painted a manual mask.

_meta.title: [5] Load SAM 2.1 Hiera-Large Segmentor
_meta.description: Segment Anything 2.1 model for crisp silhouette edges around the grounded bounding box.

_meta.title: [6] Cut Pixel-Exact Mask with SAM 2.1
_meta.description: Converts Florence-2's bounding box into an exact pixel mask and unloads SAM2 immediately to save VRAM.

_meta.title: [7] Expand (12px) & Feather (8px) Inpaint Seam
_meta.description: Gives the inpaint model breathing room around deformed edges and feathers the boundary so there is no visible cut line.

_meta.title: [8] Load FLUX DualCLIP
_meta.description: Shared text encoders for FLUX Kontext and FLUX Fill repair engines.

_meta.title: [9] Load FLUX Autoencoder (VAE)
_meta.description: Encodes Frame K for masked inpainting and decodes the repaired region.

_meta.title: [10] Repair Engine A: FLUX.1-Kontext-dev (Face / Expression / Pose)
_meta.description: Default repair engine when fixing facial likeness, eye direction, or head/shoulder posture.

_meta.title: [11] Character FLUX LoRA on Kontext (Full Identity — 0.85)
_meta.description: Applies full character identity strength when repairing faces or expressions with Kontext.

_meta.title: [12] Repair Engine B: FLUX.1-Fill-dev (Hands / Props / Background)
_meta.description: Dedicated structural inpainting engine selected automatically when repair_engine='fill'.

_meta.title: [13] Character FLUX LoRA on Fill (Capped <= 0.45 for Anatomy)
_meta.description: Deliberately lowered LoRA weight so portrait training doesn't overpower hand anatomy or prop geometry.

inputs.text: natural anatomical right hand gripping glass cup, matching warm lighting

_meta.title: [14] Surgical Repair Positive Prompt
_meta.description: Describe specifically what the masked region should look like, matching the existing lighting of Frame K.

inputs.text: deformed fingers, extra digits, blurred seam, artifacts

_meta.title: [15] Surgical Repair Negative Prompt
_meta.description: Guards against extra digits, smudged edges, and color shifts inside the mask.

_meta.title: [16] Restrict Denoising Noise Strictly to Feathered Mask
_meta.description: Locks surrounding context latents and restricts sampling noise to the dilated mask area.

_meta.title: [17] Sample Repaired Patch (Denoise 0.65 Default)
_meta.description: 0.50–0.65 gently fixes lighting/expressions; raise to 0.75–0.90 when completely reconstructing a deformed hand or prop.

_meta.title: [18] Decode Repaired Frame Candidate
_meta.description: Decodes the inpainted latent back to RGB pixels.

_meta.title: [19] Pixel-Exact Alpha Composite (100% Unmasked Preservation)
_meta.description: Guarantees zero VAE re-encoding blur outside your mask so Frame K-1 -> Frame K has an invisible seam.

_meta.title: [20] Save Repaired Frame K (Ready for Seam Check & Continuation)
_meta.description: Saves the repaired frame and triggers the 3-up Seam Comparison strip (K-1 | K Raw | K Repaired) in Director Studio.
